Allow up to 20 fresh screenshots in 90 seconds from this Kelpie tab only? Other apps cannot be captured. Returning to Kelpie, stopping capture, screen-off, expiry or device lock immediately revoke permission. The visible Stop control remains available. Tap Stop to revoke this limited session immediately.

One local approval lets your authenticated, paired agent read and operate Kelpie tabs, including while Kelpie is in the background. Screenshots contain only Kelpie web content. A visible STOP control revokes access. Payments, publishing, irreversible deletion and credentials always require separate approval.
No authenticated paired agent is connected yet. Connect your AI client, then make a new capabilities request. The agent cannot approve this screen for you.
Verified agent presence expired. Reconnect your paired client and request capabilities again.

Paired client: %1$s\n\nOne native approval for this running Kelpie process. This QA build only tests consent and STOP; remote browser actions and screenshots are NOT enabled. No other apps, lock screen or protected content may be captured. Payments, publishing, irreversible deletion and credential export need separate approval. STOP remains available in the app and notification.
Notifications are required for a visible STOP; no agent consent was granted.
Device is locked or notifications are unavailable. Consent denied.
This session request expired after five minutes. No access was granted. Please request a new session.
Consent-only QA: browser actions disabled. Use STOP to revoke.

Paired client: %1$s\n\nOne local approval for this running Kelpie process allows the verified agent to navigate Kelpie-owned pages, read their content, use safe links and fields, scroll, and capture fresh pixels from Kelpie’s private virtual WebView display while the device stays unlocked. No other apps, lock screen, system notifications or protected content can be captured. Payments, publishing, irreversible deletion and credential export need separate approval. STOP is always available in the app and Android notification. You can revoke access immediately.
Kelpie WebView agent is active. While unlocked it can read and navigate pages and capture Kelpie-only frames. STOP revokes immediately.
